products.name: YOOPAI PLA+
products.notes: yoopai.com product page (sold as 'INGEO PLA Plus Filament', made with NatureWorks Ingeo PLA): print speed under 300 mm/s, nozzle 190-230C, bed 35-65C; 1.75 +/-0.03 mm. Drying 50C 8h is NOT on the 1kg page; it comes from YOOPAI's lineup comparison chart image (PLA+ row: 190-230C, <300 mm/s, 50C 8h), which appears on the yoopai.com 250g bundle pages and on the Amazon 250g PLA+ bundle listings. The 250g 'PLA+ Starter Color Bundle' (4 or 8 rolls) and 'PLA Filament Bundle for Bambu Lab, 250g x 8' are the same PLA+ on 250g spools (135 mm OD, 53 mm hub); their text gives no settings. No 1kg non-matte PLA+ listing was found on Amazon under the YOOPAI name. Legacy Amazon 1kg listings titled 'YOOPAI PLA ... PLA+ Filament' (Sakura Pink B0FLY36P32, Yellow, Milk White) sit in the Silk PLA variation family and carry Silk PLA bullets and images (190-215C, 30-60C bed, 50-80 mm/s); treated as a listing error and not used. Fan, density not published.

products.name: YOOPAI PLA+ Matte
products.notes: yoopai.com product page: print speed under 300 mm/s, nozzle 190-230C, bed 35-60C, dry at 50C for 8h; made with NatureWorks Ingeo PLA. Amazon listings (titled 'PLA+ Matte', 'Matte PLA+', 'INGEO PLA+ Matte', 'Matte PLA Plus 4KG', older 'PLA Filament ... Soft Matte Finish' Old Yellow/Old Blue etc.) repeat the same values, and the Amazon 'Printing Parameters' image shows <300 mm/s, 190-230C, 35-60C, 50C 8h. Conflict: the Silver/Gold/Copper colour listings in the same Amazon family (e.g. B0DCBY1QSD) say 'Dry at 50C for 10 hours'. Diameter: yoopai.com says nothing; Amazon says +/-0.02 mm. Listing wording ('Elegant Muted Colors for Modern Designs ... art, fashion concepts, decor objects', 'Reduced Layer Lines') closely paraphrases SUNLU's Matte PLA listing, but the numbers are YOOPAI's own (SUNLU Matte PLA publishes 205-215C @50-100 / 215-245C @100-230 mm/s). Also sold as 250g Matte PLA+ starter bundles (4/8 rolls) and mixed PLA+/Matte/Silk 250g bundles.

products.name: YOOPAI Silk PLA
products.notes: MAJOR CONFLICT between YOOPAI sources. yoopai.com only sells this as 250g Silk PLA starter bundles (8/16 rolls); those pages give no settings in text but carry the lineup comparison chart image, PLA Silk row: 210-240C, <200 mm/s, 55C 8h. Per the source-preference rule those yoopai.com values are recorded for nozzle/speed/drying. The Amazon 1kg single-colour listings (Silver B0GTTM2977, Gold, Copper, DarkGold, RougeRed etc.), the 2kg twin packs and the Amazon 250g x8 bundle (B0GTTM396W) all say 'Recommended settings: nozzle 190-215C, bed 30-60C, speed 50-80 mm/s; slower speeds improve the silk finish'. Bed 30-60C is taken from Amazon because yoopai.com publishes no bed temperature for silk. The Amazon 1kg image gallery adds a speed/temperature table (190-215C @50-150 mm/s, 215-230C @150-250 mm/s), recorded as speed_temp_bands; note that it exceeds both the chart (<200) and the bullet text (50-80). A shop wanting the conservative Amazon text values should use 190-215C / 80 mm/s. Spool shows the Ingeo logo. 1.75 +/-0.03 mm. Silk text structure ('Neatly Wound', 'slower speeds ... silk finish') resembles SUNLU's Silk PLA+ listing, but the numbers differ from SUNLU's (205-215C, bed 60-80C, 30-60 mm/s).

products.name: YOOPAI Silk Rainbow PLA
products.notes: Four-colour silk gradient, full colour cycle about every 10 m (Rainbow 02 / 03 / 05 / Macaron). No settings in any listing text. yoopai.com 250g Silk Rainbow bundle page carries the lineup comparison chart, PLA Silk Rainbow row: 190-230C, <250 mm/s, 55C 8h (recorded). The Amazon 1kg listing (B0GT58FRB7) gallery has a parameter image: 190-215C @50-150 mm/s, 215-230C @150-250 mm/s (recorded as speed_temp_bands; consistent with the chart). Bed temperature not published anywhere. Sold as 1kg spools and 4 x 250g / 8 x 250g bundles. Spool shows the Ingeo logo; +/-0.03 mm.

products.name: YOOPAI Dual Color Silk PLA
products.notes: Two-tone coextrusion silk (Black Purple, Black Red, Blue Silver, Gold Silver, Pink Gold, Purple Gold, Red Blue, Red Gold; Purple Green appears in the 250g bundles). Not on yoopai.com. Amazon 1kg listing (B0GTTL5SSM) text: nozzle 190-215C, bed 30-60C, speed 50-80 mm/s (recorded). Its image gallery (also on the 4 x 250g dual-colour bundle B0GTTLMMFD and the Tri-Color listing) shows 190-215C @50-150 mm/s and 215-230C @150-250 mm/s (speed_temp_bands; conflicts with the 50-80 mm/s text). Drying 55C 8h is from the lineup comparison chart (generic 'PLA Silk' row) shown on the Amazon 'PLA Silk Dual Color 250g Starter Bundle' (B0H1N3SYYM); that chart's PLA Silk row also says 210-240C / <200 mm/s, which conflicts with the 1kg text. +/-0.03 mm.

products.name: YOOPAI Silk Tri-Color PLA
products.notes: 3-in-1 coextrusion silk (Red Blue Green, Black Purple Blue, Red Gold Purple, Red Yellow Blue). Not on yoopai.com. The Amazon listing text (B0GTTQMQ82) gives no settings; the only published settings are the gallery image shared with the Dual Color line: 190-215C @50-150 mm/s, 215-230C @150-250 mm/s, 'Dry before printing' (no temperature or time). Nozzle range and max speed are the envelope of those two bands. Bed and drying not published. Also sold in a 4 x 250g tri-colour bundle. +/-0.03 mm.

products.name: YOOPAI PETG
products.notes: COPIED FROM CREALITY: the yoopai.com and Amazon text for this PETG is Creality's CR-PETG listing text nearly word for word, with 'Creality' changed to 'Our' (same typo 'enbale', same 'especially suitable for Creality 3D Printers!', same 220-250C nozzle / 70-80C bed). On Amazon it shares a variation family with the 'Official CREALITY PETG' listings that YOOPAI resells, and a newer relisting is titled 'YOOPAI Official PETG ... Better Flow, Moistureproof 3D Printing CR PETG Filament' (B0H45PG846), echoing Creality's title. Recorded values are YOOPAI's published text (yoopai.com black/transparent pages): nozzle 220-250C, bed 70-80C. The 'Printing Setting' image on the same yoopai.com pages says nozzle 230-250C, bed 60-80C, print speed <300 mm/s (max speed taken from that image; Creality's CR-PETG spool label also says 230-250C). Images also say 'Drying for 4-6 hours before printing is recommended' (no temperature; drying_hours = upper bound 6) and HDT 70C at 0.45 MPa. 1.75 +/-0.03 mm. Colours include Black, Transparent, Grey, Red, Yellow, and 'A-...-new' transparent colours.

products.name: YOOPAI PETG HF
products.notes: Amazon only (the solid 'A-1kg' colours of YOOPAI's newer PETG family: Black, Grey, Cream, Red, Yellow, Blue, Purple, Forest Green, Peanut Brown; e.g. B0G2XY3BNJ, titled 'PETG HF Black, 30-600mm/s Rapid Printing'). Text: supports up to 600 mm/s, 'optimal below 300 mm/s'; Recommended Settings: nozzle 230-260C, bed 65-75C, print speed <300 mm/s (300 recorded; 600 is the marketing claim). Gallery image: recommended drying 60-65C, 6-8 hours (drying_temp_c = lower bound, drying_hours = upper bound). The 'PETG HF' name matches Bambu Lab's product name and the 'High Toughness, Odorless, Better Flow' title wording echoes Creality's CR-PETG title; the settings themselves are YOOPAI's own. 1.75 +/-0.03 mm.

products.name: YOOPAI PETG Transparent
products.notes: High-clarity PETG, Amazon only ('B-1kg' sub-line of YOOPAI's newer PETG family): Transparent, Transparent Grey, Light Blue, Orange, plus translucent gradients (Blue to Purple, Pink to Yellow, Blue to Green, Blue to White). Plain Transparent listing (B0GK8CQSPX) text: nozzle 230-260C, bed 65-75C, speed <=220 mm/s, slower improves clarity (recorded). CONFLICT: the 'YOOPAI Translucent PETG ... Blue-Purple Gradient, High Speed' listing (B0GK8333QY) says nozzle 220-260C, bed 60-80C, speed 50-300 mm/s. The shared gallery image says nozzle 230-260C, bed 65-75C, <300 mm/s, and drying 60-65C for 6-8 hours (drying_temp_c = lower bound, drying_hours = upper bound). 1.75 +/-0.03 mm.

products.name: YOOPAI PETG Multicolor
products.notes: Gradient multicolour PETG, Amazon only ('C-1kg' sub-line): 'Crystal' gradients (Blue, Rainbow, Shadow Red) and 'Vivid' gradients (Abyss Blue, Coral Reef, Cosmic Blue, Enchanted Forest; one Vivid listing is titled 'PETG ... Silk Rainbow'). Listing text (B0GH5S9DSQ and siblings): nozzle 220-270C (first layer 255C, other layers 230C), speed first layer 50 mm/s, other layers <150 mm/s; suggests 10% honeycomb infill. Bed is not in the text; 65-75C is from the shared gallery image, which also says nozzle 230-260C and <300 mm/s (conflicts with the text) and drying 60-65C for 6-8 hours (drying_temp_c = lower bound, drying_hours = upper bound). 1.75 +/-0.03 mm.
